# Harvous

> Harvous is a Bible study notes app — a Bible notes alternative focused on helping you remember and reconnect with what you saved from Scripture.

Harvous is a notes app first, not built around sermon transcription or AI-generated sermon summaries. It includes a Bible reader — browse the canon or type a reference — so your notes, highlights, and scripture-linked insights can live right next to the text, organized in threads and folders so you can find them again.

## Key differentiators

- Notes-first: scripture pills, highlights, and references linked to your writing
- Opens on Activity — the study you already did, a sheet per day, rather than a blank page
- Built-in Bible reader that feeds your notes — browse or type a reference in one of 11 translations, open the chapter, and your notes/highlights for it are right there
- No sermon transcription focus — capture what matters to you, not auto-generated transcripts
- Suggestions: resurface notes, highlights, and passages worth revisiting (called Recall before Harvous 3)
- Review (Harvous Plus): answer a question about your own notes from memory, then say how it went — no AI-written questions, no score
- Search from the top middle finds anything you have saved
- Shared Spaces, threads, and folders that organize themselves around what you study — hosting a space is Plus, joining is always free

## Bright Enough — the Harvous blog

Bright Enough is editorial content about teaching craft, retention after Sunday, study habits, and notes-first Bible study — for teachers, pastors, group leaders, churches, and anyone who wants learning to last.
